Home.title: Performance Management Platform
Home.description: A centralized workspace for performance cycles, objectives, evaluations and results.

Auth.title: Welcome back
Auth.subtitle: Sign in to your performance workspace

ObjectivePlan.text007: What do you want to achieve?
ObjectivePlan.text008: Write one clear outcome, not a task list...
ObjectivePlan.text010: Define how success will be measured
ObjectivePlan.text028: Build a clear, measurable plan for each employee.
ObjectivePlan.text034: Choose a starting point. You can edit everything before submission.
ObjectivePlan.text036: Sample template loaded. This is demo data.
ObjectivePlan.text038: Previous-period sample copied to a new draft.
ObjectivePlan.text046: Keep each objective focused. Add KPIs to make success measurable.
ObjectivePlan.text051: Complete the checks below before continuing.
ObjectivePlan.text055: At least one KPI per objective
ObjectivePlan.text056: KPI details completed and target above zero
ObjectivePlan.text057: SMART score is at least 70% for every KPI
ObjectivePlan.text059: Demo draft saved in the current page only.
ObjectivePlan.text061: All checks passed. This is a local preview; nothing was submitted.
ObjectivePlan.text064: Templates, SMART scoring and wording suggestions are illustrative local features. Changes are not saved to the backend.
ObjectivePlan.text065: Return blocked: add an Objective/KPI comment.
ObjectivePlan.text066: Decision blocked by KPI weight, target or SMART validation.
ObjectivePlan.text067: Demo approval preview recorded; next stage is Employee Review.
ObjectivePlan.text068: Demo return preview recorded; manager correction is required.
ObjectivePlan.text070: Review objectives and KPIs, comment, edit permitted plan fields, approve or return.
ObjectivePlan.text082: Local demo only. Return requires at least one Objective/KPI-level comment. Approval requires valid KPI weights, targets and SMART scores. The BRD has conflicting UC-013 statements about whether Admin may directly edit submitted Objectives/KPIs; this edit mode is a review prototype pending business confirmation. No actual workflow action occurs.
ObjectivePlan.text084: Review return reasons, correct the plan and follow the correct resubmission path.
ObjectivePlan.text089: Fix KPI fields and ensure total weight is 100%.
ObjectivePlan.text090: Demo: resubmitted to Pending Admin Approval.
ObjectivePlan.text091: Demo: routed directly to Employee Review; Admin visibility retained.
ObjectivePlan.text093: Demo transition only. Admin-returned plans go back to Admin review. Employee-returned plans go directly to Employee Review under the later UC-015 activity steps, although earlier UC-015 wording also says every resubmission requires Admin review; confirm this conflict before production. Prior versions are not persisted.
ObjectivePlan.text095: Transparent period and annual calculation examples.
ObjectivePlan.text106: Illustrative values only. Annual objective result requires all applicable periods. Scores remain provisional until the Manager–Year Group is approved; this screen does not publish results.
ObjectivePlan.text108: Inspect provisional rating distribution without inventing unavailable thresholds or calibration rules.
ObjectivePlan.text114: Bell Curve compliance is intentionally not calculated
ObjectivePlan.text115: Approved minimum/maximum percentages are not supplied. The BRD also conflicts between blocking submission without automatic rating movement and automatically calibrating ratings. This workspace displays score-based distribution only and never changes ratings.
ObjectivePlan.text116: No compliance pass/fail result or rating calibration is asserted. The business owner must resolve the BRD conflict before that behavior is implemented.
ObjectivePlan.text117: Review annual evaluation completion and provisional rating distribution for the full manager-year population.
ObjectivePlan.text119: Eligible employees across applicable cycles · demo records
ObjectivePlan.text134: Some evaluations are incomplete and approved Bell Curve minimum/maximum thresholds are not supplied. Complete all eligible employee evaluations and confirm the approved distribution policy before group submission. No rating is automatically moved.
ObjectivePlan.text135: This is a read-only readiness preview. Completion is not user-editable and no group submission occurs because the demo has pending evaluations and unresolved Bell Curve thresholds.

CompetencyTemplates.text001: Enter the template name in English and Arabic.
CompetencyTemplates.text002: Every group needs bilingual names and at least one competency.
CompetencyTemplates.text003: Complete each competency's bilingual name, description and positive weight.
CompetencyTemplates.text005: Map the template to at least one unassigned Job Title.
CompetencyTemplates.text006: Job Title already mapped to another template:
CompetencyTemplates.text007: This template is locked because it is used by an Active Performance Cycle.
CompetencyTemplates.text008: Enter both template names before saving a draft.
CompetencyTemplates.text009: Template activated in local demo state. No employee assignment was performed.
CompetencyTemplates.text010: Draft saved in local demo state.
CompetencyTemplates.text011: Template removed from local demo state.
CompetencyTemplates.text013: Build competency groups, configure weights and map templates to Job Titles.
CompetencyTemplates.text015: Demo data · changes are not persisted
CompetencyTemplates.text018: Competencies are evaluated annually only. The template weight must total 100%.
CompetencyTemplates.text021: This template is currently used by an Active Performance Cycle. Structure, competencies, weights and Job Title mappings cannot be modified or deleted. Existing performance records retain their assigned configuration.
CompetencyTemplates.text026: Each group requires a bilingual name and at least one competency.
CompetencyTemplates.text041: A Job Title can belong to one Competency Template only. Assigned titles are marked and unavailable.
CompetencyTemplates.text060: Templates are automatically assigned to employees according to their Job Title.
CompetencyTemplates.text074: Illustrative records only. Draft, activation, copy, deletion and Job Title mapping are local demo interactions. Backend persistence, employee auto-assignment and active-cycle locking must be enforced by the server.

ObjectiveConfiguration.text003: Category updated in local demo state.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text004: Category added in local demo state.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text005: Category removed from future selection. Historical references are preserved in this demo.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text007: Maintain the categories available to Managers when creating or updating Performance Plans.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text009: Demo data · not connected to backend
ObjectiveConfiguration.text025: Deleting a category removes it from future selection but does not delete historical references. Approved or finalized Performance Plans retain their original category information. Changes should be reflected immediately in new and editable plans once backend integration is complete.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text027: Category Name is required and must be unique.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text032: This category will no longer be available for new selections. Historical references and approved plans will remain unchanged.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text034: Each component must be between 0% and 100%.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text035: The total component weight must equal exactly 100%.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text036: Configuration updated in local demo state. Finalized historical results are not recalculated.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text039: Configure the annual weighting applied to the Overall Annual Performance Result.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text042: The overall annual result is calculated from two weighted components.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text056: Previous values and new values are retained for historical result traceability.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text062: No configuration changes recorded in this demo session.
ObjectiveConfiguration.text063: Only Admin may configure these weights. The configured values apply to future annual calculations (UC-020); finalized historical results must retain the weights previously applied. Audit entries shown here are local demo records, not persisted server audit history.

PerformanceCycles.text001: Complete both cycle names and the start date.
PerformanceCycles.text002: Select at least one eligible employee.
PerformanceCycles.text003: All five stage deadlines are required.
PerformanceCycles.text004: Each configured deadline must fall within the first generated period.
PerformanceCycles.text005: Stage deadlines must be in chronological order.
PerformanceCycles.text007: Configure the annual cycle, employee scope and first-period stage deadlines.
PerformanceCycles.text009: Demo configuration · not saved to Backend
PerformanceCycles.text011: The record is held in this page's local state only and will reset on refresh. No notifications or workflow activation were sent.
PerformanceCycles.text014: Each cycle covers one annual performance year.
PerformanceCycles.text023: Select departments, job titles and/or individual employees. Duplicates are merged.
PerformanceCycles.text036: Employees with less than six months of service are excluded by default. Admin may include them as an exception. Other exclusion categories remain subject to approved eligibility rules.
PerformanceCycles.text039: Jisr sync, service-length calculation and other exclusion categories are mocked here. Production eligibility must come from the latest successful Jisr sync and backend policy.
PerformanceCycles.text041: Configure the five workflow deadlines once. The same relative pattern is previewed for subsequent periods.
PerformanceCycles.text043: Activation requires valid cycle information, dates, scope and deadlines.
PerformanceCycles.text048: Closed cycles cannot be edited under this workflow.
PerformanceCycles.text054: For Active cycles, dates before today are treated as completed and locked in this illustrative view. Production must use authoritative workflow stage status from Backend, not infer completion from dates alone.
PerformanceCycles.text055: Changes must stay within the cycle and selected period, in chronological order.
PerformanceCycles.text057: Each editable deadline must be within the cycle and applicable period.
PerformanceCycles.text058: Stage deadlines must remain in chronological order.
PerformanceCycles.text060: Demo changes validated. Audit entries are shown below; no Backend record was updated.
PerformanceCycles.text062: Old value, new value, user and date/time as required by UC-008.
PerformanceCycles.text064: Cycle configuration, generated periods and employee scope.
PerformanceCycles.text071: Included employees are grouped by their direct manager. Period statuses are illustrative and completed periods are read-only.
PerformanceCycles.text081: Already assigned to another active cycle
PerformanceCycles.text086: Illustrative sample only. Manual inclusion changes local page state and demonstrates the under-six-month exception; it does not update Jisr, the backend, notifications or any employee workflow. Employees assigned to another active cycle cannot be manually included here.
PerformanceCycles.text088: Create, configure and monitor annual performance cycles.
PerformanceCycles.text099: Search and filter by cycle name, year, frequency and status.
PerformanceCycles.text109: Demo records and filters only. Create, activation, employee scope, Jisr eligibility, notifications and workflow progress are not persisted or connected to Backend APIs.

Notifications.text002: Stay on top of your performance workflow
Notifications.text003: Workflow notifications are shown according to your demo role. Open an item to continue in the relevant workspace.
Notifications.text008: Based on predefined BRD notification types
Notifications.text015: Try another filter or search term.
Notifications.text016: Demo data only. Read status is held in page state and resets on refresh. Production notifications, recipients, delivery, persistence and access scope must be supplied and enforced by backend services.
Notifications.text017: Complete the English and Arabic subject and message body before saving.
Notifications.text020: Edit predefined Arabic and English subjects and message bodies. Triggers, recipients and workflow conditions remain fixed.
Notifications.text029: The BRD provides the recipient, title and related use case for NOT-017, but does not provide English or Arabic message-body text. The fields are intentionally left blank until approved copy is supplied; saving requires all four content fields.
Notifications.text038: UC-027: Only authorized Admin users can edit existing Arabic and English subjects and message bodies. Creating/deleting notification types or changing recipients, triggers and workflow conditions is not permitted. Changes apply to future notifications only. Demo edits are not persisted to a server.

AdminFinalReview.text002: Review the Manager–Year Group, verify completeness and record a group-level decision.
AdminFinalReview.text007: Submitted by: People Manager · Cycle: 2026 · Frequency: Quarterly
AdminFinalReview.text019: Review objectives, competencies, overall score and rating for each member.
AdminFinalReview.text029: This demo contains incomplete employee records. The BRD requires group completeness before final approval; do not infer missing scores.
AdminFinalReview.text031: Review visible score components. Detailed KPI actuals, comments, evidence and workflow history are illustrative only.
AdminFinalReview.text037: Approve the group or return it to the manager with a mandatory reason.
AdminFinalReview.text038: Approval is blocked: incomplete employee evaluations and unverified Bell Curve policy.
AdminFinalReview.text042: Send the entire group back for updates
AdminFinalReview.text044: Select the employees whose permitted final-period evaluation inputs need revision.
AdminFinalReview.text047: Enter decision notes or required corrections…
AdminFinalReview.text054: Frontend prototype only. Decisions update this local screen state; no backend workflow, notification, publication or audit record is created.
